content:
Maya: Quick UX review — thinking about moving units & smoothing controls out of the axis label into the legend area for dense dashboard charts. Less clutter on axis, easier discoverability?
Liam: curious — can you sketch the interaction? dropdown? inline toggle?
Maya: idea: compact legend row with a small chevron \u2193 that expands settings: Units, Smoothing, Outlier handling. default shows unit abbreviation (e.g., ms) and value precision.
Olivia: I like reducing axis copy. Concern: discoverability for keyboard/screenreader users. If we hide controls in a collapsed panel, need clear focus and aria labels.
Sam: agree on ARIA. Also need copy for the collapsed state: maybe "Units & smoothing" or "Display settings"?
Maya: provisional copy: "Display settings — units, smoothing, outliers". When collapsed, legend shows: "Throughput — ms · p50" (click chevron to edit).
Liam: small nit: "ms · p50" might confuse novice users. Maybe show full name on hover and a tooltip: "Latency (milliseconds) — p50 median".
Olivia: tooltip + accessible name. For screen readers, expose a button with label: `Edit display settings for Throughput chart` and `aria-expanded` toggles. Also provide a visible keyboard focus ring.
Sam: UX + dev sync: for the collapsed schema, can we provide quick toggles (radio) for units and a smoothing slider (0-1)? Example config: 
```
{ "legend": { "compact": true, "unitDisplay": "auto", "smoothing": 0.2, "outlierPolicy": "fade" }
}
```
Maya: thanks. On outliers: proposal to default to "fade" for single spikes, and "cap" for sustained tails. Need a short copy for policy choices: "Fade — deemphasize transient spikes" vs "Cap — clamp extreme values".
Liam: good. Also suggest a small visual hint on the axis when capping is active: a little caret at top with tooltip "values capped at 99th pct".
Olivia: accessibility check: when capping/fading is applied, ensure the alt text for the chart includes the policy used, e.g., `data-visualization: throughput chart (units: ms) — outlier policy: capped at 99th percentile` so screen readers get same context.
Sam: implementation note: prefer storing user preference per-dashboard rather than global, users expect per-chart granularity. backend flag: `displaySettings.scope = "chart" | "dashboard"`.
Maya: visual prototypes attached in Figma (link pasted) — https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/display-settings-legend — please review layout: compact row, chevron, expanded panel with quick toggles + "Advanced" to open full inspector.
Liam: one more copy thing: button text should be concise: use "Display" not "Display settings" to keep legend compact.
Olivia: keyboard flow: Tab lands on legend toggle, Enter expands, next Tab lands on first control (unit select), then smoothing, outlier. Shift+Tab should go back. Provide `role="menu"` or `role="dialog"`? Dialog feels heavy. Maybe `role="menu"` plus descriptive `aria-label`.
Sam: dev feasibility: `role="menu"` is fine but ensure custom controls inside are accessible. We can implement as an aria-expanded button + popup div.
DesignBot: Reminder: design tokens updated last week — spacing for legend items decreased from 8px to 6px; check prototypes for overflow on narrow panels.
Maya: thanks all — action items: Olivia to write aria text snippets, Sam to prototype config payload, Liam to finalize copy, Maya will iterate Figma & post updated frames.
Olivia: I'll drop a sample aria snippet here by EOD.
Sam: will sketch JSON & API contract in the next PR.
Liam: happy path tested? also think about mobile compactness — maybe collapse legend to an icon-only row on narrow widths.
Maya: noted — mobile fallback: icon-only with tap-to-expand.
Olivia: quick accessibility copy draft: `aria-label="Display settings for Throughput chart. Units: milliseconds. Smoothing: medium. Outlier policy: fade (transient spikes deemphasized)."`
Maya: perfect. closing thread unless objections. :thumbsup:
